study type: Nested case-control study within a cohort
cohort: A cohort of 2548 pregnant women residing in urban areas of Hadiya Zone, south Ethiopia, who were followed up until delivery, with their newborns forming the basis for cases (with birth asphyxia) and controls (without birth asphyxia).
finding: Induction of labor, prolonged labor, delivery through cesarean section, instrumental delivery, and low birth weight were identified as significant determinants of birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: Delivery through cesarean section and instrumental delivery were significant determinants of birth asphyxia.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was an exposure measured.
